entry.title: Severe Thunderstorm Watch
entry.summary:
There is a moderate risk of severe thunderstorms with localised downpours (25 to 40 mm per hour) over Auckland and Great Barrier Island from late morning until this evening.
Rainfall of this intensity can cause surface and/or flash flooding, especially about low-lying areas such as streams, rivers or narrow valleys, and may also lead to slips.
Driving conditions will also be hazardous with surface flooding and poor visibility in heavy rain.

There is moderate risk of severe thunderstorms with localised downpours (25 to 40 mm per hour) for Northland until this evening.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain. Localised downpours possible with rainfall intensities of 25 to 40 mm/h. Rainfall amounts may exceed warning criteria in localised areas. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.
